Andover Country Club

Andover, MA

The Course →

Welcome to Andover Country Club, a private eighteen-hole club in Andover, MA. For over 100 years, we have continued to offer our members and guests the highest level of service and hospitality. On site: elegant ballrooms for weddings & events, fine dining restaurant and lounge, members bar, putting green, pro shop, the links restaurant, 19th hole pub and patio, banquet ballrooms, real estate/homes within the community.

Our course.

Eighteen holes.

[andover country club] noun — eighteen holes in Andover, mapped hole by hole from the air.

Home / Member Tee Times

Member Tee Times

Members and their guests

Book online.

Book from your phone.

Members reserve from a phone; guests play with a member. This is the Lightspeed Golf member tee sheet as it would sit on your site: date, players, holes, then a tap to book. The pro shop keeps the sheet, the rules and the phone line.

Call the pro shop (978) 475-1263
Andover Country Club · Member tee timesConcept widget · Lightspeed Golf — example times, not live availability
Players
Holes
On the live site this is the real Lightspeed Golf widget: it shows the tee sheet you control and takes the booking. Nothing here is bookable.

How it works

You set the tee sheet

Which times are open to members, which to guests, how far ahead people can book. Blocks for leagues and tournaments stay blocked.

Golfers book in seconds

From this page or their phone. Confirmations go out by email or text; the pro shop sees every booking on its screen.

The phone still works

Walk-ups and phone bookings go on the same sheet. Nothing about how the course runs changes until you decide.

Booking systems we connect

  • Lightspeed Golf

    Our recommendation for a member club: online tee sheet, member and guest rules, point-of-sale for the pro shop, no obligation to give away tee times.

  • foreUP

    Widely used tee-sheet and booking system with a strong mobile booking flow.

  • Teesnap

    Tee sheet, booking and pro-shop point-of-sale in one iPad-based system.

History

For over 100 years, we have continued to offer our members and guests the highest level of service and hospitality..

Andover Country Club has been a favorite wedding destination for greater Boston couples for 100 years..

House rules

  • Appropriate golf attire/business casual is required in the clubhouse and restaurant.
  • Proper golf attire required at all times on Club property, excluding cut-offs, denim, gym shorts, swim trunks, and sleeveless/collarless shirts for men.
  • Mobile phones must be on silent mode and are prohibited in food and beverage outlets.
